title: MANDT MANDT
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:59 AM
MANDT MANDT

OFFIC OFFIC_KK

CHDSK CHDSK_KK

-INCLUDE CI_FKKEXC_CL
MYFIELD

2. Add your entry/entries in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |*Basic Functions } Open Item
Management » Specify Selection Categories

The field names must match the field names in structure CIFKKEXC_CL and you must set the External Selection
Criterion indicator for each field that you enter. In our example, add the following entry in Customizing:

Application Area R
Selection Type 1

Meaning Invoice Field Name MYFIELD

3. Define event 6210. That is, in this event, convert the external selection criteria into internal selection criteria. You can do this
as follows, for example:

=, Sample Code
FUNCTION Z_FKK SAMPLE 0210.

KHeee eee ee ee ee ee ee eee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee eee ee eee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee eee eee eee
*"*"|okale Schnittstelle:
*N   IMPORTING

*N     VALUE(I_SELTAB) LIKE ISELTAB STRUCTURE ISELTAB
*" TABLES

*"      T_SELTAB STRUCTURE ISELTAB

*"   EXCEPTIONS

*"      UNKNOWN SELECTION

KM ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee ee eee eee ee eee

IF i _seltab-selfn = 'MYFIELD'.
IF i_seltab-selcu = '0123456789'.

t_Seltab-selnr = '0001'.
t_seltab-selfn = 'OPBEL'.
t_seltab-selcu = '000000004711'.

APPEND t_seltab.
ENDIF.
ENDIF.
ENDFUNCTION.

Repetition of a Posting

Use

You can automatically select payments received by XI and that could not be posted directly using the repetition process and
trigger their posting again.
